import json,random,subprocess,time,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
img=json.load(open('/app/tmp/maximg.json'))
rng=random.Random(5)
addrs=[ref.fmt(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(20000)]
# also hit actual prefixes
for st in img['stages'][:4]:
    for nd in st['nodes'][:50]:
        pr=nd['prefix']
        L=int(pr.split('/')[1])
        for _ in range(20):
            addrs.append(pr.split('/')[0])
lk=json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs})
print('lookup MB %.2f'%(len(lk)/1e6))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=lk+'\n', text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=200)
print('lookup %.2fs rc=%d out=%d'%(time.time()-t,p.returncode,len(p.stdout)))
r=json.loads(p.stdout); assert r['status']=='ok'
import importlib.util as iu
sp=iu.spec_from_file_location('mm','/app/submit/main.py'); mm=iu.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(mm)
fl=[]
for st in img['stages']:
    for nd in st['nodes']:
        for x in nd['rules']:
            n,L=mm.parse_prefix(x['prefix']); fl.append((n,L,x['hop']))
bad=0
for a,ans in zip(addrs, r['answers']):
    v=mm.parse_addr(a); h,L=ref.lpm(fl,v)
    exp={'hop':h,'prefix_length':L} if L>=0 else {'hop':None,'prefix_length':None}
    if ans!=exp: bad+=1
print('mismatches',bad,'answers',len(r['answers']))
assert bad==0
print('OK')
